items.headline: NASA and ESA Astronauts Complete Spacewalk to Install High-Speed Antenna
items.summary: On August 25, 2026, NASA astronaut Anil Menon and ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot completed a six-and-a-half-hour spacewalk outside the International Space Station. The duo successfully installed and connected a new high-speed Space-to-Ground antenna to restore vital data communications between Mission Control and the orbiting laboratory.

items.headline: Tadej Pogačar Takes Vuelta a España Lead with Masterclass Solo Win
items.summary: Slovenian cyclist Tadej Pogačar launched a 50-kilometer solo attack during stage four of the Vuelta a España on Tuesday to take a dominant victory in Andorra [2.2.7]. His impressive performance earned him a stage win by over two minutes and expanded his overall general classification lead to more than three minutes.
